corrections: Nominal service times are not real ones: in all three local experiments asyncio.sleep overshot by 1 to 2 ms, so runs aimed at 70/90/95% ran at 75/96/101-106%. The page reports measured utilisation everywhere and states the gap.
Root's 2x peak factor (illustrative) is confirmed for a one-region product (German Wikipedia 1.92x) and shown to be high for a global one (English 1.24x).
Python free-threading status: supported but optional since 3.14 (PEP 779 phase II), not experimental; 3.15 final is scheduled for 2026-10-09 (not yet released on 2026-10-04).
Redis does not evict by default (maxmemory-policy noeviction in the shipped redis.conf); a cache needs an explicit policy.
Open-source nginx has no active health checks (commercial only); passive max_fails=1, fail_timeout=10s by default.
unconfirmed: TTL jitter is labelled as advice, not from a single primary source.
Harchol-Balter textbook recommended without chapter-level checking.
